name: Education Major: Prekindergarten-Twelfth Grade (PK-12)
description: Preschool-12 certification is available in art, French, health and physical education, music, Spanish, and teaching English to speakers of other languages (TESOL). Special education is offered as a K-12 major. One of the following BA programs must also be completed: Secondary Education Major, BA Elementary Education Major: Birth-Kindergarten (B-K) Elementary Education Major: Prekindergarten-Third Grade (PK-3) Elementary Education Major: Third-Sixth Grade (3-6) Music Education PK-12, BME Special Education K-12 Major: Cognitive Impairment, BA (certification in special education only) Options should be discussed with an education advisor.
